new_candidates.body:
### Bug description

On current main (`62ff3a5`), `ManiSkillTrajectoryDataset(..., success_only=True)` fails when the first recorded episode is unsuccessful and a later episode is successful. The loader skips episode index 0, but observation initialization is conditional on that original index. Later observations are appended to `None`, and conversion raises `AttributeError`.

A minimal dataset has two trajectories with array observations/actions and the usual terminated/truncated fields, plus a JSON episode list with `success` values `[false, true]`. Loading that file with `success_only=True` reproduces the failure for NumPy storage and `device="cpu"`; retaining the first episode is a passing control.

### Proposed fix and tested patch

Initialize observations when `self.obs is None`, so the first retained episode initializes the buffer. Apply the identical one-condition change to the copied documentation example. This does not change filtering, load_count, empty-selection semantics or outcome-label conversion.

Ready patch and regression tests: [compare branch](https://github.com/mani-skill/ManiSkill/compare/main...wpyaoxueros:ManiSkill:codex/fix-first-successful-trajectory), commit `fb7df4d`.

- 16 CPU/NumPy cases cover arrays/nested observations, filtering enabled/disabled, both episode orders and subsequent appending: baseline 4 failed/12 passed; fixed 16 passed.
- Additional actual CUDA tensor-storage checks: baseline 2 failed/6 passed; fixed 8 passed. This is not a full GPU physics-suite result.
- Black 22.10.0, isort 5.12.0, dependency and whitespace checks passed.
- Full CPU/GPU physics suites have not completed because the test assets are unavailable in the current environment.

This is separate from outcome-label issue #1499 / PR #1500. Following CONTRIBUTING's maintainer-approval step, would a PR limited to this initialization fix and tests be welcome?

AI disclosure: investigation, patch, regression tests and static review were assisted by an AI coding agent. No independent human review is claimed.


Tested implementation submitted as draft PR #1503: https://github.com/mani-skill/ManiSkill/pull/1503 . Maintainer scope approval and complete project validation are still pending; no approval or merge is claimed.
